placement_restriction_findings: No program checked bans AI-generated or aggregator sites in the terms retrieved. Bans found: Higgsfield (paid ads, brand bidding, coupon/cashback sites), Framer (coupon/cashback sites, brand bidding, search-ad placement, spam), n8n (paid ad campaigns), TradingView (brand-keyword bidding, unsolicited messaging). Full PartnerStack/Impact terms for ElevenLabs, Webflow, Lovable, Coursera, Skillshare, Setapp, Udemy were not readable without an account; check them at application time.
